newsitem.title: JAPAN: Marubeni Energy imports kerosene from South Korea.
newsitem.headline: Marubeni Energy imports kerosene from South Korea.

text.p: Marubeni Energy Co Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of trading house Marubeni Corp, said on Thursday that it imported 3,000 kilolitres of kerosene from South Korea's Hyundai Oil Refinery Co earlier this month.

Marubeni Energy, an oil product wholesaler, has an agreement with the South Korean refiner, which is an unlisted unit of the Hyundai Group, to import four to five cargoes of kerosene a year, a Marubeni Energy official said.
The first shipment of kerosene was lifted at Tomakomai, on Japan's northern island of Hokkaido, he said.
Marubeni Energy declined to disclose the price of the shipment.
Japan's oil product import market was liberalised in April, enabling companies other than oil firms to import petroleum products such as kerosene and gasoline.
Trading houses and a farmer's group have taken advantage of the deregulation.
Demand for kerosene, used for heating in Japan, peaks during the winter.
